entries.name: Bradford Lyttle

expected.charges: [albany-first-1963] Continuing the integrated march through the downtown business district — Albany, Georgia.
expected.sentence:
Held from December 23, 1963. The prisoners were released in two groups, on January 16 and January 17, 1964, and the CNVA bulletin does not say which day was his; the EARLIER date is used here, so the figure is a floor rather than a guess. If he left on the 17th the term was one day longer.

Charges as recorded: [albany-first-1963] Continuing the integrated march through the downtown business district — Albany, Georgia. Lyttle was one of fourteen arrested.

updates.sentence: Sentenced January 8, 1964 to a $102 fine or 25 days, with prior custody credited. Released in January; the reports describe releases on January 16 and 17 without identifying his individual day.

entries.rationale: Original reports name Lyttle at January 8 sentencing. Replace deliberately selected release floor with month precision, not a purported exact date.

entries.name: Ross Anderson

expected.charges: Failure to obey an officer during a vigil supporting jailed peace walkers in Albany, Georgia.
expected.sentence: Arrested during the January 1, 1964 support vigil; declined bail and remained jailed pending trial. Individual release date and full custody total are unresolved.

updates.sentence: Arrested January 9, 1964 and declined bail. Sentenced January 14 to 31 days, with 30 suspended. Released that month; the individual release day remains unresolved. The sentence is not a time-served total.

entries.rationale: Visually verified CNVA roster prints January 9, misread as January 1 in old OCR. Release bulletin and Catholic Worker confirm January 14 sentence for the six named supporters.
